intent_record.intent_summary: Add a safe absolute value helper function for s32 that avoids undefined behavior at S32_MIN boundary.
intent_record.what: Added a new static helper function `abs_s32()` that computes the absolute value of a signed 32-bit integer by casting to unsigned before negation, with a comment explaining it avoids undefined behavior for S32_MIN.
intent_record.how: This function provides a safe way to compute absolute values of s32 integers. The standard approach of negating a signed value is undefined behavior when the value is S32_MIN (the most negative representable s32). By casting to unsigned before negation, the function leverages well-defined unsigned arithmetic semantics to produce the correct absolute value without triggering undefined behavior.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit ec0e2da95f72d4a46050a4d994e4fe471474fd80
Author: Yonghong Song <yonghong.song@linux.dev>

    bpf: Support new signed div/mod instructions.
    
    Add interpreter/jit support for new signed div/mod insns.
    The new signed div/mod instructions are encoded with
    unsigned div/mod instructions plus insn->off == 1.
    Also add basic verifier support to ensure new insns get

    Acked-by: Eduard Zingerman <eddyz87@gmail.com>

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces signed division/modulo support using the `abs()` macro on s32 operands. In the ALU_MOD_X, ALU_MOD_K, ALU_DIV_X, and ALU_DIV_K cases with OFF==1, the code calls `abs((s32)DST)` and `abs((s32)SRC)` or `abs((s32)IMM)`. The `abs()` macro exhibits undefined behavior when applied to S32_MIN (0x80000000/-2147483648), as the absolute value of S32_MIN cannot be represented in a signed 32-bit integer. For example, in ALU_MOD_X case 1: `AX = abs((s32)DST); AX = do_div(AX, abs((s32)SRC));` - if DST or SRC is S32_MIN, abs() produces undefined behavior. This diverges from the verifier's abstract interpretation which would handle S32_MIN correctly. The fix would require using safe absolute value functions that handle S32_MIN without undefined behavior, but this commit does not include such handling.
